articles.title: Gecko Robotics lands $71M Navy deal to send wall-climbing robots inside warships
articles.summary: A Pittsburgh AI startup is partnering with the U.S. Navy to create digital twins of Pacific Fleet vessels, starting with 18 ships. This initiative aims to address the Navy's severe maintenance crisis, which costs up to $20 billion annually. The AI platform will improve vessel upkeep, optimize repairs, and enhance operational readiness by providing virtual models for predictive analysis and efficient management.
